segments.name: Analog
segments.description: Designs and sells analog semiconductors that condition real-world signals and manage power for electronics designers and manufacturers in industrial, automotive and other markets.
segments.evidence: Our Analog segment includes the following major product lines: Power and Signal Chain.

segments.name: Embedded Processing
segments.description: Provides digital 'brains' of electronic equipment, including microcontrollers and processors, used mainly in industrial and automotive markets.
segments.evidence: Our Embedded Processing segment includes microcontrollers, processors, wireless connectivity and radar products.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds remaining business activities, including DLP products, calculators and custom ASICs, plus corporate items not allocated to segments.
segments.evidence: Other generated $979 million of revenue in 2025 and includes revenue from DLP ® products (primarily used to project high-definition images), calculators and certain custom semiconductors known as application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs).

changes.text: In 2025, TI realigned its end markets to better reflect growth opportunities for its analog and embedded products.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we realigned our markets to better reflect the growth opportunities for our analog and embedded products.
